about: Typed meals for eval-food-ai.mjs. The first twenty carry the calorie range a careful person would accept (standard reference values, plus or minus about a fifth). beer-half and wine-glass (added 2026-11-18) check that a drink keeps the calories of its alcohol (truth from USDA via src/data/foods.ts). The sixteen packaged products after them (added 2026-11-18) carry truth from the maker's label as read from Open Food Facts (product code in `reference`), times the stated package, kept only where the label's energy agrees with 4P+4C+9F within about 6%; tolerance plus or minus 15%. expect 'not_food' means the analysis should refuse.
